articles.title: How to make a bilty (lorry receipt)
articles.summary: Make a bilty or lorry receipt in Nivesh Sahayak: trip, consignor and consignee, packages and weight, freight paid or to pay, GST reverse or forward charge.

articles.title: How to use Trips and fleet
articles.summary: Keep trips per vehicle: freight, advance, diesel, toll, driver cash, commission, hamali. See vehicle profit, driver statement, freight dues and paper due dates.
